svg.text: TCP Close is fed ONLY from Test_CellOCV_Burst’s pass-through refnum — never branched back
from TCP Open. Branch the refnum and you have two owners of one socket; close it while the
burst VI is mid-read and you get error 66 that looks like a DUT fault. Chain handles, branch data.
Both VIs measure the same 96 cells — one cell per query, then all 96 in one burst. Subtract them
elementwise, take |max|, and if it is under 1 mV the hex/CAN decoder is proven correct.
The grey wire is the TCP connection refnum, olive is the error cluster, orange is the DBL array
(96 elements), and the limits cluster is drawn orange here — LabVIEW draws it brown.
the refnum is CHAINED, never branched
